runtime: native Termux via existing SSH shell

commands.static_inspection: metadata and keyword-only inspection of ~/.termux/boot regular files; no script executed

managed_ssh_8023.kernel_listener_owner: unverified; proc TCP observation permission denied

interpretation: An executable Termux:Boot script references the managed 8023 service by name, and that service is currently running and reachable on loopback. This is evidence of configured boot intent, not proof that Android delivered the script after a cold boot or that the observed listener is owned by the managed service. Cold-boot delivery, startup completion, remote reachability, and listener ownership remain open gates.

tests.scope: full repository unit/fixture suite; tests make no Android boot or service changes
